title: Drafts and temporary chats · Phase 2.3
description: Independent protected drafts for each conversation and memory-only temporary chats.
notes: Ordinary conversation drafts are kept separately, including after switching chats or reopening Lumen. Unsent new chats are available in Drafts in the sidebar.
Drafts use protected, account-scoped files and migrate older drafts without deleting their original until the protected save succeeds.

Start Temporary chat from the sidebar. Its messages, versions and drafts remain in memory and are excluded from local history, cloud sync and restoration. Leaving asks before clearing; your chosen AI provider still receives the messages.
